ability.infinity.time_stone.season_in_a_: Four local seasons in 12 seconds. Spring, summer and autumn advance up to 96 existing wheat, carrot, potato or beetroot crops within 8 blocks; winter brings visual snow. No global weather or time changes. Losing the Stone ends the event.
ability.infinity.time_stone.closed_time_: Up to 3 visible hostiles repeat 6 seconds: every 2 seconds they return to their safe starting position and suffer 60 damage. Bosses receive damage without teleporting. Losing the Stone ends the loop.
death.attack.infinity_closed_time_loop.i: %1$s was trapped in %2$s's time loop using %3$s
ability.infinity.time_stone.temporal_ech: For 6 seconds your first 3 successful hits create echoes after 0.5 and 1 second, each dealing half the confirmed health loss, up to 80. Echoes cannot create more echoes. Losing the Stone cancels pending echoes.
death.attack.infinity_temporal_echo.item: %1$s was caught in %2$s's temporal echo using %3$s
ability.infinity.time_stone.personal_rew: Return to a safe personal position from up to 5 seconds ago, recover lost health and remove newly acquired harmful effects. Does not rewind items, XP or cooldowns. Requires at least 1 second of safe history.
ability.infinity.soul_stone.reaper_brand: Mark an aimed hostile for 6 seconds. Your confirmed damage feeds the seal, up to 200. It ruptures for 60 plus its charge. Losing the Stone cancels the seal.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.flight.descr: Grants you the power of flight. This ability can be toggled on or off if you wish to use another form of flight.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.intangibilit: Allows you to phase through blocks and entities, becoming untouchable to the physical world.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.passive.desc: Pacifies hostile mobs around you, causing them to become peaceful. Sneak while activating to undo the effect.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.un_passive.d: Removes pacification from nearby hostile mobs, restoring their aggression.
Fires a concentrated energy beam from the Scepter, dealing massive damage to whatever it strikes.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.remove_mind_: Safely removes the Mind Stone from the Scepter and returns it to your possession.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.recipe.descr: Floods your mind with infinite knowledge, unlocking access to every crafting recipe.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.hero.descrip: Your presence inspires admiration and trust. Villagers see you as a true hero.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.night_vision: Enhances your perception, allowing you to see clearly even in complete darkness.
ability.infinity.power_stone.impower.des: It gives the player both health boost and resistance
ability.infinity.power_stone.knockback.d: It grants the player knockback resistance
ability.infinity.power_stone.explosion.d: Without protection, the player is bombarded with cosmic radiation, destroying the environment and user in the process.
The player used to be bombarded with cosmic radiation, destroying the environment and user in the process, but it can now be controlled.
ability.infinity.power_stone.meteor_stor: The Power Stone shatters a distant moon, while the Space Stone pulls the fragments toward the target. Using them together creates a devastating, large-scale attack that requires both stones. (Don't spam, it might cause lag)
ability.infinity.power_stone.punch.descr: It grants the player 30 attack damage
ability.infinity.power_stone.punch2.desc: It grants the player 70 attack damage
ability.infinity.power_stone.punch3.desc: It grants the player 100 attack damage
ability.infinity.power_stone.punch4.desc: It grants the player 300 attack damage
ability.infinity.power_stone.punch5.desc: It grants the player 3000 attack damage
ability.infinity.power_stone.punch6.desc: It grants the player a near infinite attack damage
ability.infinity.power_stone.power_blast: A powerful beam that gets stronger the more punch upgrade you unlock. It has a range of 100 blocks, smelts blocks and causes fire. It will turn rainbow and do explosion damage if all 6 stones are collected. Does not work with other suits, only the gauntlet.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.save_dumm: Any block you look at gets added to your inventory
ability.infinity.reality_stone.normal.de: Returns the player to normal scale
ability.infinity.reality_stone.effects.d: Gives entities nearby blindness, nausea, darkness and slowness
ability.infinity.reality_stone.remove_re: Removes the Reality Stone and returns it to your possession
ability.infinity.reality_stone.bubble.de: Turns the block you look at into bubbles (stand ~2 blocks away)
ability.infinity.soul_stone.immortal.des: Makes you completely immortal. Requires all stones to be inserted
ability.infinity.soul_stone.effect_immun: Gives you immunity to most negative effects
ability.infinity.soul_stone.summon_zombi: Summons 7 Zombies. Can pair with the Mind Stone's pacify ability to create a strong army
ability.infinity.soul_stone.enter_soulwo: Lets you, and nearby entities, enter the SoulWorld. Shift to exit
ability.infinity.soul_stone.exit_soulwor: Lets you, and nearby entities, exit the SoulWorld
ability.infinity.soul_stone.locateplayer: Use the locateplayer command: locateplayer <entity_name>. Designed for players, but works with named entities
ability.infinity.space_stone.teleport.de: Teleport to wherever you are looking
ability.infinity.space_stone.telekinesis: Use telekinesis to grab, move, and damage entities from a distance
ability.infinity.space_stone.force_field: Creates an impenetrable force field that makes you invulnerable but unable to move
ability.infinity.space_stone.step_assist: Allows you to step up full blocks without jumping
ability.infinity.space_stone.black_hole_: Creates a devastating black hole that consumes entities and blocks. Requires the Power Stone
ability.infinity.space_stone.remove_spac: Extracts the Space Stone from the Tesseract
ability.infinity.time_stone.slow_time_du: Manipulate the flow of time by scrolling forward or backward. The sidebar indicates how fast or slow time is flowing, with the center representing normal speed.
ability.infinity.time_stone.accelerate_t: Accelerates the passage of time, causing the world to move faster than normal.
ability.infinity.time_stone.reset_time_s: Resets the flow of time back to its natural state.
ability.infinity.time_stone.time_freeze_: Completely halts time. Press once to freeze time, and again to resume it.
ability.infinity.time_stone.stop_time.de: Stops the daylight cycle entirely until reactivated.
ability.infinity.time_stone.projectile_s: Stops all projectiles in midair. Once you leave the area, they will eventually regain momentum.
ability.infinity.time_stone.time_set.des: Grants access to the time_set command, allowing direct control over the world's time.
ability.infinity.time_stone.remove_time_: Removes the Time Stone from the Eye of Agamotto. (Shift Left Click from Eye of Agamotto)
Unlock by right-clicking with a Vibranium Flux Capacitor in your main hand. Equip this skin and keep it on for one full in-game day to heal the burn damage caused by the Snap.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.fantastic_four: Unlock by right-clicking with an unknown item. A special skin inspired by the Fantastic Four.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.netherite_gaun: Unlock by right-clicking with a Netherite Ingot in your main hand. Applies a reinforced Netherite Gauntlet skin.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.soul_netherite: Unlock by right-clicking with a Soul-Infused Netherite Ingot in your main hand. A darker, more powerful evolution of the Netherite Gauntlet.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.finger_gauntle: Unlock by holding a piece of raw chicken. A questionable gauntlet variant that is, quite literally, finger-lickin’ good.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.hand_of_terror: Unlock by right-clicking with an object that still holds remnants of power. A custom gauntlet skin requested by Terror.
Unlock by right-clicking with an Uru Ingot in your main hand. A gauntlet forged with dark influence.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.endosym_gauntl: Unlock by right-clicking with an Endosymbiotic Ingot in your main hand. A living, adaptive gauntlet skin.
Unlock by right-clicking with Cherry Planks in your main hand. A refined Rose-Gold styled gauntlet.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.normal_gauntle: Removes the currently applied gauntlet skin and restores the original Infinity Gauntlet. Any consumed unlock items will be returned.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.omni_desc.desc: With Pugmeowla's Infintrix, Alien Evolution, Into the Omniverse, and Omnitrix Evolution omnitrixes can act as gauntlets. Equip an omnitrix, hold a stone, and right-click. No Infinity Gauntlet needed.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.offhand_desc.d: For best results, equip the Infinity Gauntlet in the Hands Curios slot or the offhand. Using the main hand may limit functionality. The gauntlet will not be visible in first person when placed in the offhand.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.snap_desc.desc: After performing the Snap, you will be severely weakened and burned. Your health is reduced to half a heart, and several stone abilities are disabled. You must wait one full in-game day before snapping again. Equip the Nano Gauntlet skin to heal the burn damage.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.ftg_gauntlet.d: Unlock by right-clicking with Ferro-Titanium-Gold Alloy Ingot in your main hand.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.panther_gauntl: Unlock by right-clicking with Vibranium Ingot in your main hand.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.ultron_gauntle: Unlock by right-clicking with Vibranium Circuit in your main hand.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.cartoon_gauntl: Unlock by right-clicking with White Wool in your main hand.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.midnight.descr: Unlock by right-clicking with Black Dye in your main hand.
Unlock by right-clicking with an (NP-Λ52) Unit in your main hand. An enhanced gauntlet with NP-Λ52, capable of stabilizing and channeling the energy of the Infinity Stones, fully compatible with the Mark 52-D.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.flight_toggl: Unlock this to toggle mind stone flight on and off, incase you want to use another form of flight.
Locked permanently when CoreWithStuff is not present.
Same as Curios, but Trinkets for Fabric.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.cws_desc.descr: When CoreWithStuff is downloaded, it provides a custom GUI. Hold the infinity gauntlet in main hand, and right click to open. There is still an option to use the default insert system, but that might cause issues with syncing.
ability.infinity.time_stone.screen_toggl: Toggles on and off the green screen overlay.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.blaze_inc_gaun: Unlock by right-clicking with a Quartz Flux Capacitor in your main hand. Dedicated to Blaze Inc, this gauntlet skin is a tribute to their contributions to the palladium community :)
ability.infinity.gauntlet.dragon_gauntle: Unlock by right-clicking with a Dragon Head in your main hand.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.cosmi-rod_desc: To insert a stone, hold the Cosmi-Rod in your main hand and right-click with the stone in your offhand.
To remove a stone, hold the Cosmi-Rod in your main hand and shift-right-click.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.shrink_du: Allows for size changing, scroll when toggled on.
ability.infinity.power_stone.radiation_t: Toggles on and off the radiation texture overlay.
ability.infinity.orb.reset_progress.desc: Resets the Orb's unlock progress, allowing you to unlock it again if you wish.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.psionic_mast: The Mind Stone shields its chosen mind with 20 armor toughness.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.psionic_over: Focus the Mind Stone into a devastating golden psionic beam projected from your gaze.
ability.infinity.power_stone.cosmic_reso: The Power Stone floods its bearer with celestial force, adding 100 attack damage.
ability.infinity.power_stone.celestial_a: Channel a catastrophic violet beam that melts terrain and tears through anything in its path.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.reality_d: The Aether hardens around its wielder, granting 30 armor against any rewritten outcome.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.reality_s: Fire a scarlet rift that forcefully rewrites blocks and enemies caught at its impact point.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.aether_tr: For 6 seconds, turn up to 32 incoming hostile projectiles into harmless petals and bubbles. Allied shots remain untouched.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.crimson_l: Raise a red aether wall for 8 seconds: hostile monsters cannot cross it, and their projectiles dissolve. You and your allies pass freely.
ability.infinity.soul_stone.soul_soverei: Your soul becomes untouchable by fire, falls, drowning, freezing, explosions, projectiles, and lightning.
ability.infinity.soul_stone.soul_severan: Launch a blazing soul-rift that devastates everything where it strikes.
ability.infinity.space_stone.spatial_sov: Space bends around its master, granting 60 additional maximum health.
ability.infinity.space_stone.event_horiz: Launch a collapsing spatial singularity that erases a wide section of the battlefield.
ability.infinity.time_stone.chronal_mast: Your personal timeline accelerates, adding 80% movement speed.
ability.infinity.time_stone.temporal_cat: Accelerate yourself beyond time while every nearby non-player entity is locked in an instant.
ability.infinity.gauntlet.eternity_conve: With all six stones installed, briefly become an unstoppable cosmic nexus.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.synaptic_cas: Strike a hostile mind and leap through up to six nearby enemies, dealing 80 psychic damage and interrupting each target.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.psychic_domi: Seize up to three hostile minds for 12 seconds and turn them against nearby monsters. Bosses resist control but suffer severe Weakness.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.terror_proje: Project psychic terror through a wide cone, dealing 60 damage and forcing up to eight hostile minds to flee for 5 seconds. Bosses resist fear but suffer crushing Weakness.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.mental_basti: Raise an 8-second psychic sanctuary that cleanses harmful effects, reduces damage to you and nearby allies by 75%, and violently repels each hostile intruder once.
ability.infinity.power_stone.titanic_cha: Turn the Power Stone's force into a charge of up to 16 blocks that stops at walls and deals 160 damage to every enemy crossed.
ability.infinity.power_stone.tectonic_re: Rip the ground ahead for up to 24 blocks with a violet energy fissure that deals 120 damage and launches every enemy struck without destroying terrain.
ability.infinity.power_stone.kinetic_res: Raise a 5-second guard that absorbs 75% of incoming damage and stores up to 240 energy. Your next melee hit within 10 seconds releases the entire reserve.
ability.infinity.power_stone.cosmic_arse: Summon five asymmetric Power Stone shards for 8 seconds. Each shard fires once at the enemy under your aim and deals 90 damage.
ability.infinity.space_stone.spatial_exc: Instantly exchange positions with the hostile under your aim up to 32 blocks away, leaving it disoriented for 3 seconds. The exchange aborts if either destination is obstructed or unsafe.
ability.infinity.space_stone.orbital_jud: Bind up to five nearby hostiles with continuous spatial beams for 3 seconds, then crush them for 180 damage. Bosses resist displacement but not the final compression.
ability.infinity.space_stone.spatial_ref: For 5 seconds, bend up to 32 incoming hostile arrows and potions back toward their source. Friendly projectiles pass untouched.
ability.infinity.space_stone.spatial_ban: Banish one living target under your aim to a safe landing on the central End island. Right click on the wheel (or Shift) sends it above the Nether roof instead. Players require server PvP.
No valid target or safe destination
ability.infinity.reality_stone.reality_c: Bind the player under your aim and open their real inventory to choose which items to take, including armor, offhand and accessories. Closing the screen releases them; access lasts up to 60 seconds. Hold Shift to make them drop everything instead. Requires server PvP.
No eligible player under your aim
ability.infinity.soul_stone.soul_sanctua: Create a fixed sanctuary for 10 seconds, 6 blocks wide in radius. Restore 8 health per second and cleanse harmful effects from yourself, teammates and your pets. Allies inside resist incoming damage; leaving the circle removes its protection. Void and administrative removal are not blocked.
ability.infinity.soul_stone.spirit_legio: Summon three spectral sentinels for 15 seconds. They follow you and strike up to three visible hostiles within 16 blocks for 30 damage per attack. They leave no items or XP, cannot pick up equipment and vanish when your power ends.
ability.infinity.soul_stone.essence_siph: For 5 seconds, drain up to five visible hostiles within 10 blocks for 20 damage per second. Restore 25% of their actual lost health, up to 12 health per pulse. Allies are untouched and invulnerable targets grant no healing.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.harmless_: Rewrite a common hostile under your aim as a harmless chicken for 8 seconds. Its identity, health and equipment are preserved, and its original form returns when the spell ends. Bosses resist the rewrite.
infinity.skill.mind_stone.description: The Mind Stone answers to you while you carry it. Unlock its powers with /infinity_tree mind.
infinity.skill.power_stone.description: The Power Stone answers to you while you carry it. Unlock its powers with /infinity_tree power.
infinity.skill.space_stone.description: The Space Stone answers to you while you carry it. Unlock its powers with /infinity_tree space.
infinity.skill.reality_stone.description: The Reality Stone answers to you while you carry it. Unlock its powers with /infinity_tree reality.
infinity.skill.soul_stone.description: The Soul Stone answers to you while you carry it. Unlock its powers with /infinity_tree soul.
infinity.skill.time_stone.description: The Time Stone answers to you while you carry it. Unlock its powers with /infinity_tree time.
infinity.skill.immortality.description: Press to switch on or off. While on and carrying the Soul Stone, death cannot take you (you are left at 1 health). Off by default.
infinity.tree.unknown_stone: Unknown stone. Use mind, power, space, reality, soul or time.
infinity.tree.not_learned: You have not bonded with this stone yet. Carry it first.
infinity.tree.result.unknown_node: There is no such ability in this tree.
infinity.tree.result.not_buyable: This ability unlocks by itself once its requirements are met.
infinity.tree.result.need_stone: You must be carrying this stone.
infinity.tree.result.locked_parent: Unlock the previous ability in the tree first.
infinity.tree.result.need_other_stones: This ability needs the other stones with you.
infinity.tree.result.not_enough: You cannot pay the cost yet.
infinity.wheel.title: Infinity Wheel
infinity.wheel.hint: LMB: use  ·  RMB: 2nd option  ·  MMB: destination  ·  1-4: favourites  ·  Scroll: level
infinity.wheel.state.locked: Locked — unlock it in the tree
infinity.wheel.dual.reality_confiscation: Left: open inventory  ·  Right: drop everything
infinity.wheel.dual.spatial_banishment: Left: End  ·  Right: Nether roof  ·  Middle: pick destination
infinity.dest.title: Destination
infinity.dest.tip_auto: Automatic Y finds the highest safe floor at X/Z (below the ceiling in roofed dimensions).
infinity.dest.tip_exact: Exact Y: if the body does not fit it rises to free space. Over the void, it falls.
infinity.dest.default.end: Central End island, next to the exit portal.
infinity.dest.default.nether: On top of the Nether bedrock roof.
infinity.dest.default.other: Safe floor near 0, 0 of this dimension.
infinity.dest.unknown_dimension: That dimension does not exist on this server.
infinity.dest.no_safe_spot: No safe spot at that destination.
infinity.dest.back.title: Bring it back
infinity.dest.back.sub: Returns it to where it came from
infinity.dest.back.empty: Nobody banished by you this session.
infinity.dest.back.not_loaded: Target too far: loading the area, click again in a few seconds.
infinity.tree.title: Infinity Stones
infinity.tree.tab_hint: Power tree of the stones you carry
infinity.tree.pick: Click a node to inspect it. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, 1–6 switch stone, R recentres.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.will.desc: Hard light of reality. Left on the wheel: Grip (hold Left to take any mob, player, item or Create Aeronautics contraption; release to fling it; Right locks it in the air; Alt + mouse turns it). Middle: construct wheel. Right: manage constructs. No cooldown, no weight limit.
infinity.will.hud.title: ✦ MATTER MANIPULATION ✦
infinity.will.hud.idle: Hold Left: grab  ·  Right (aiming at something locked): unlock  ·  Middle: unlock all
infinity.will.hud.holding: Release Left: let go (keeps momentum)  ·  Right: lock in the air  ·  Scroll: distance  ·  Alt + mouse: turn
infinity.wheel.dual.will_construct: Left: Grip (on/off)  ·  Right: manage constructs  ·  Middle: construct wheel
infinity.will.hud.design: DESIGNING: %s hard-light blocks (free)  ·  Right on the power: save or cancel
infinity.construct.title: Hard-Light Constructs
infinity.construct.name: Name...
infinity.construct.design_help: Place blocks normally: each one becomes hard light and returns to your hand. Create parts work on the construct. Type a name and press SAVE.
infinity.construct.empty: No saved constructs. Make a new one or copy a Create Aeronautics contraption.
infinity.construct.legend: Left: summon  ·  Right: dismiss copies  ·  Middle: move up  ·  ⚒ edit blocks  ·  ✎ rename
infinity.construct.quick_legend: Left: summon / pick  ·  Right: dismiss that one  ·  Middle: manage
infinity.construct.design.start: Designing with hard light — place blocks
infinity.construct.no_contraption: Aim at a Create Aeronautics contraption
infinity.construct.no_space: No free space to summon here
ability.infinity.port.needs_scepter: Hold the Scepter to fire the Power Blast
ability.infinity.soul_stone.soul_possess: Left: possess the aimed mob — free third-person camera, WASD/jump/attack drive it and Right/Middle click use its native attacks (creeper explodes, blaze/ghast shoot, dragon breathes...). Right: list of online players — you enter the chosen one's eyes without them noticing anything; G takes full control of the body (walk, look, attack, use, inventory) and gives it back. Your body stays invisible and untouchable until you release.
ability.infinity.soul_stone.soul_capture: Left: tear out the aimed mob's soul and pull it into the Stone (the body shrinks into your hand). Right: stored souls menu with 3D previews — release, execute, send to the Soul World or release already possessed.
infinity.wheel.dual.soul_possession: Left: possess mob  ·  Right: possess player
infinity.soul.possess.nobody: No other player online to possess.
infinity.soul.possess.lost: The soul slipped away — possession broken.
infinity.soul.jar.exiled: %s was cast into the Soul World.
infinity.soul.hud.title: ✦ POSSESSION — %s ✦
infinity.soul.hud.hint_mob: WASD/Jump move · Ctrl sprint · Left attack · Right/Middle mob powers · [%s] Release
infinity.soul.menu.players_hint: Click to enter their eyes · Right closes
infinity.soul.menu.jar_empty: No souls stored. Use Soul Capture (Left) on a mob.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.psychic_avat: Toggle. Your mind leaves your body: the body kneels as a golden shell and you fly as an invisible golden projection. Mobs cannot see you, you cannot break/place blocks or attack, and you see living beings nearby through walls. scroll: leash 32 to 96 blocks. If the body is hit, the projection takes damage or you pass the leash, the mind snaps back and the damage lands.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.phantasm.des: Left: release a double of yourself that runs where you look; mobs switch to it and you turn invisible (armour too) for 8 s. Whoever hits the double makes it shatter into golden shards that blind and nauseate. Right: detonate the double (blindness and nausea in 5 blocks).
ability.infinity.mind_stone.suggestion.d: Aim and give a mental order. Left: apply the chosen order. Right: order menu — Sleep, Flee, Fight for me, Freeze, Persuade. Bosses are immune.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.hive_mind.de: Left (aiming): golden threads seize up to 8 mobs in the cone in front of you for 20 s and they attack the aimed target — even cows hit. Use again on another target to retarget. Right: release them all. scroll: radius 6 to 16.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.nightmare.de: Conjunction Mind + Soul. The aimed creature falls into a nightmare for 10 s. Player: darkness, creeper hisses, footsteps and whispers only they hear from every side, shaking screen, racing heartbeat and a wandering camera. Mob: panics and flees from you, and its pack scatters.
infinity.extra.mind.boss: This boss's mind is too strong
infinity.extra.mind.avatar.cant: Your mind cannot leave your body right now
infinity.extra.mind.avatar.leash: The leash snapped — back to your body!
infinity.extra.mind.avatar.hit: Your body was hit — snapping back!
infinity.extra.mind.suggestion.sleep.des: The mob stops and sleeps for 15 s (wakes when hurt). Player: heavy drowsiness.
infinity.extra.mind.suggestion.flee.desc: The target flees from you for 10 s. Player: thrown away.
infinity.extra.mind.suggestion.fight.des: The mob attacks your enemies for 20 s (whatever you hit first).
infinity.extra.mind.suggestion.freeze.de: Rooted for 6 s. Player: stuck in place, free to look around.
Villager: positive gossip (better prices). Piglin: calms down and barters once (every 5 min). Player: looks at you for 3 s. Other mobs: stay calm toward you.
infinity.extra.mind.suggestion.fight_pla: Players do not obey this order
infinity.extra.mind.hive.nobody: No mobs to seize in the cone
ability.infinity.power_stone.celestial_n: Aim a point (up to 160 blocks): colossal layered magic circles open in the sky above it, spin faster and faster and pour down a beam that annihilates everything — lethal at the centre, shockwaves, debris and a crater (only with mobGriefing). scroll: scale 1–3.
ability.infinity.power_stone.cataclysm_f: Left: start forging an orb that absorbs the surroundings (up to 4 s); left again: hurl it at the aimed point. Right: cancel. Becomes Storm, Inferno, Tide, Blizzard or Earthquake depending on the place. scroll: size 1–3.
ability.infinity.power_stone.debris_orbi: Left: tear up to 8 light copies of the ground blocks; they orbit you for 30 s and block projectiles. Left again: fire one at the aimed target. Right: fire them all.
Left: empower the aimed ally (or yourself): +30% size, Strength II and knockback immunity for 20 s. Right: turn the aimed enemy into an unstable bomb that explodes in 3 s.
ability.infinity.power_stone.seismic_wav: Left: a crest of earth races along the ground where you look and launches everything up. Right: a ring around you pushes everything outward. scroll: reach 10–30.
ability.infinity.power_stone.meteor_gate: Conjunction Power + Space. A rift opens in the sky above the aimed point and drops magma meteors one after another (10 damage each, fire). scroll: count 3–9.
ability.infinity.power_stone.convergence: Conjunction: Power + any other carried stone. Each stone becomes an orb that converges above your head and fires a braided beam at the aim. Damage grows with the stones: 2→20, 3→35, 4→55, 5→80, 6→lethal.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.reality_p: Reality says it is yours. Left (aiming) at a mob: it becomes your pet (red crown, never despawns, never attacks you or allies); at your own pet: select it (orders go to it alone). Right: order menu — Sit, Follow (teleports to you when far), Attack target (your next left click on a creature picks the target; even cows deal damage), Guard here, Release. Max 8 pets; no bosses; another player's pet can't be stolen. Your pets defend you automatically.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.broken_mo: On/off. Reality glitches around you: blocks flicker into other blocks for everyone nearby, your screen gets a red aberration, your hits glitch the target (short teleport + 30% damage) and ALL your Reality abilities are ×1.5. Price: you take +25% damage and hunger drains fast.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.local_dec: Laws of reality. Left (aiming): decree the chosen law in a rune circle at the aimed point for 45 s. Right: law menu — Peace, Lightness, Weight, Silence, Inversion. scroll: radius 6–16. Applies to everyone inside, you included. One decree per player.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.mirage.de: Lie to other people's eyes. Left (aiming at a block): the N×N square on the aimed face looks like the block in your off hand to other players (empty hand = invisible); the real block does not change. You see a red outline. 2 min, up to 64 blocks. Right: undo all. scroll: size 1–5.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.metamorph: Rewrite the species. Left (aiming at a mob): it bursts into red fragments and becomes the chosen species, keeping its name and % of health. Right: species menu. scroll: change species. Mobs only (no players or bosses).
infinity.extra.reality_pet.name: %s's Pet
infinity.extra.reality_pet.no_target: Aim at a creature to attack
infinity.extra.reality_pet.boss: Bosses do not bow to Reality
infinity.extra.reality_pet.taken: That is already another player's pet
infinity.extra.reality_pet.deselected: Selection cleared: orders go to all pets nearby
infinity.extra.reality_pet.armed: Left click a creature to pick the target
infinity.extra.reality_pet.follow.desc: They follow you and teleport along when far
infinity.extra.reality_pet.attack.desc: Your next left click on a creature picks the target of all pets nearby
infinity.extra.reality_pet.guard.desc: They patrol radius 8 around this spot and attack hostiles
infinity.extra.reality_pet.release.desc: Breaks the bond (the selected one, or all nearby)
infinity.extra.local_decree.law.weight.d: Crushing gravity: no jumping, elytras fail, projectiles plummet
No sound from inside is heard
infinity.extra.mirage.not_block: Your off hand must hold a block (or be empty)

Left again: release. Right: drag the cube with its prisoner to where you look (up to 24 blocks). Bosses are immune.

Lasts 3 min; one zone per player.
ability.infinity.time_stone.stasis_bubbl: Left: a green dome of clocks at the aimed point for 8 s (radius 3–8 on scroll). Inside, time STOPS for everyone but you and your allies: mobs freeze in mid-air, projectiles hang, players cannot move, falls and fire stop. All damage dealt to the frozen is stored and lands at once when the bubble breaks. Right: pop your bubble. Bosses are immune.

Use again to rewind (or wait 10 s): it returns to exactly that instant along a trail of green ghosts. Allies (and you) also get their health, fire and hunger back; enemies only their position.
Left: a FAST field at the aimed point for 30 s; right: a SLOW field. Speed ×2–×10 on scroll. Fast: plants, saplings, copper, furnaces, blast furnaces, smokers, campfires, brewing stands and baby animals run N times faster; anyone inside gets Speed and Haste. Slow: mobs, players and projectiles of non-allies run at 1/N speed.

A green wave sweeps through: Aging cracks and moss-covers stone and bricks, oxidises copper, chips anvils, ripens crops, grows saplings into trees and babies into adults, and wears dropped tools. Rejuvenating does the opposite. Nothing is destroyed.
Time + Reality conjunction. Left: undo the explosions of the last 5 min around you (radius 8–32 on scroll) in green and red waves: blocks destroyed by creepers, TNT, ghasts, withers... fly back into place with their original state (only where the spot is still empty). Items the explosion dropped that are still on the ground are taken back.

ability.infinity.soul_stone.gauntlet_sna: Complete gauntlet. Half of every creature in every loaded world turns to dust and is sent away. Never touched: you, your allies, any player's pets and tamed animals, name-tagged creatures, the Dragon and bosses. Other players only with PvP on — they go to the Soulworld, they don't die. Burns your arm for one Minecraft day (20 min).
ability.infinity.soul_stone.gauntlet_ret: Complete gauntlet. Everything you sent away with the Snap or the Purge comes back. Left: all of them reappear around you (players too). Right: each returns to the exact spot it vanished from (unloaded areas wait for next time).
ability.infinity.soul_stone.gauntlet_und: Complete gauntlet. The aimed player (or you) gets back what their last death took: items still lying on the ground fly back into the inventory, and the lost experience levels too.
ability.infinity.power_stone.gauntlet_ex: Complete gauntlet. Left: execute the aimed player (up to 256 blocks). Right: execute every other player on the server. Server PvP and teams are respected. Burns your arm for one day.
ability.infinity.power_stone.gauntlet_pu: Complete gauntlet. Every hostile monster in the loaded worlds turns to dust (pets and bosses stay). They come back with Bring Back. Burns your arm for one day.

ability.infinity.mind_stone.gauntlet_dom: Complete gauntlet. Left: every creature within 48 blocks becomes your pet, no limit (not bosses or other people's pets). Right: all your loaded pets come to you.
ability.infinity.time_stone.gauntlet_sto: Complete gauntlet. Everything within 96 blocks stops for 10 s except you and your allies. Damage you deal meanwhile lands all at once when time resumes.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.gauntlet_: Complete gauntlet. Left: the aimed creature becomes a harmless animal. Right: every hostile within 32 blocks does.
Complete gauntlet in hand. Starts a 17.5 s ritual (turning it off cancels). At the end the six stones in the gauntlet are destroyed for good, your arm burns and you are thrown into the Soulworld.
ability.infinity.space_stone.gauntlet_co: Complete gauntlet. For 25 s you become a cosmic nexus: huge absorption, resistance, regeneration, strength and speed; creatures within 48 blocks glow.

ability.infinity.soul_stone.spectral_arm: Left: the souls of creatures that died near you in the last 60 s climb out of the ground in an orange rune circle and fight for you for 30 s, tougher, glowing, dropping nothing. Right: calls 4 spectral knights from the other side (for when nobody died nearby). Up to 8 spectres at a time; the oldest fades when you raise more. They never hurt you or allies.
ability.infinity.soul_stone.reaper.title: Reaper
ability.infinity.soul_stone.reaper.descr: Left: a giant spectral scythe sweeps a 180° arc in front of you (7 blocks) in a few ticks: whoever is cut loses its soul — heavy damage, and the soul flies into you as health (a golden shield beyond full health). Right (Harvest): a rune circle opens around you and every creature below 1/3 of its health inside the radius is reaped on the spot; the souls come to you. Bosses cannot be reaped. scroll on the wheel: Harvest radius (6–20).
ability.infinity.soul_stone.soul_link.de: Left (aim): the aimed creature and up to 5 more within 12 blocks of it are chained by orange soul threads for 15 s — the damage one takes, all the others take 70% of too; when one dies the threads snap and tear 6 from each survivor. Right (aim an ally or pet; players must be sneaking): a bond between you and them for 30 s — each takes only half of every hit (the other half goes to the partner) and healing is shared. Bosses never join the web.
Left: signs a pact with your soul where you stand (a rune circle and a pillar of light mark the spot). For 10 minutes, if you would die you don't: your soul is pulled back to the pact spot with your whole inventory, once (the pact is spent). Right: tear the pact up. Works in multiplayer, without OP; an admin's /kill is not blocked.
ability.infinity.time_stone.past_echo.de: Time + Soul conjunction. While you carry both stones the world around you is remembered: creature positions within 24 blocks are kept for the last 10 s. Left (aim): the aimed creature's last 10 s become a ghost — it appears where that creature stood 10 s ago and re-lives the whole path in 3 s, slashing everything it passes (1.5× damage), then stays 20 s at your side as a spectral fighter. Right: the echo of yourself. Up to 2 echoes; the creature must have been in range for 2 s.
ability.infinity.space_stone.soul_rift.d: Space + Soul conjunction. Left (aim at the ground): a rift of orange and blue light tears open in the air above the spot under a giant double rune circle and for 6 s drags everything within 12 blocks toward the centre (players too; bosses are hurt but not dragged) while souls pour in, hurting more the closer they get. Using it again (or the end of the time) collapses the rift: a giant shockwave deals 24, and the souls it swallowed (up to 4 that died in it) return as spectral allies for 30 s. No blocks are touched.

You become a small blue planet: rings of light and three moons circle you, you float down softly and everything in reach is caught in orbit (up to 8 creatures, bosses excepted, and 14 items or projectiles). Enemies in orbit cannot fight and take 2 damage per second. Sneak to sling everything outward (6 damage to creatures). scroll: capture radius 4-10.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.paint_wor: Reality becomes a canvas. Left (aimed): the exposed surface within 9 blocks of the aimed point is repainted in a spreading wave under layered red rune circles, with the palette chosen with scroll: Candy, Gold, Crystal or Crimson. Right: wipe your paint now. It lasts 60 s and then washes off from the outside in; every block returns with its exact original state (anything broken or replaced meanwhile is never touched). Painted blocks drop nothing (no free items), and logs, leaves, ores, chests and unbreakable blocks are left out. Only with mobGriefing on and where the player may build. One paint per player.

It is all private: nobody else sees or hears it, nothing changes in the world and the creatures' real teams are given back when it turns off.
ability.infinity.soul_stone.lost_lantern: The first use lights a floating soul lantern at your shoulder. It gathers the soul of every creature that dies within 32 blocks of it (up to 24; it also takes the ones that died in the last 30 s around you). Left (aimed): releases the whole lantern as a homing swarm: each soul hits for 3.5 and seeks the next enemy if its prey dies. Right: the souls rush into you and your allies as healing and a golden shield; with an empty lantern, right puts it out. No block is touched; it vanishes if you die or log out.

Left: you rewind 5 s: in about a second you fly backwards along your own footsteps, leaving green afterimages, over a reversed clock, and arrive with the health, hunger and fire you had then (never less than now) and no harmful effects. Right: a quick 1.5 s blink back to dodge. Resistance protects you on the trip. Nothing else in the world is touched. The memory clears on death, dimension change, logout and after each rewind.

Whenever YOU hit something they blink next to it in a flash of time and echo the blow (60% of your damage each) a moment later. Right: send the clones back. ability.infinity.time_stone.alternate_ti: Conjunction Time + Reality (with the Reality Stone on you). Left: opens a ghost world around you (radius 8–20 with scroll) for 10 s under a red and green dome. Inside, everything may be destroyed (digging, TNT, creepers), because when the time is over (or you use it again) every broken block flies back into place from the inside out with its original state (only where the spot is empty: builds made meanwhile are never overwritten). To keep it dupe-free: blocks broken inside drop nothing, falling blocks do not form, items thrown by explosions vanish and no loose item can be picked up until the end. Chests and other block entities are immune in the zone. One zone per player.

Choose the item and the amount (up to 27 stacks): an energy falls from the sky, the item materialises in the beam and dives into the chest, the lid closes and glowing orbs carry the items to you. Left: open the menu. Right: repeat the last request. No OP needed. What does not fit your inventory drops at your feet and only you can pick it up.

ability.infinity.space_stone.spiritual_g: Left: opens the online player list (checkboxes, "Take everyone", "Only me" and "Confirm"). You rise 30 blocks and fly freely; every chosen player sees a portal and an angelic hand of light that pulls them into a circle around you, separated from you by a ring of water. Everybody sees a Japanese dojo (cherry trees, torii, lanterns, mountains, petals and fog) that hides the real world. The gathered can only look: they cannot move, attack or use anything, and teleport powers do not work on them; your other powers work normally. Use again to end it: the scenery dissolves and, 2 s later, hands send everyone back to where they came from with Haste III and Regeneration II for 5 min. 2 s after the last one is back, you snap back to where you activated it. Anyone carrying no stone who presses the wheel key prays to the Space Stone holder.
